title: Data Leakage in Visual Datasets
mechanism: Quantify leakage of evaluation images into training data via near-duplicate retrieval.
adaptation: Near-duplicate search (embedding + pixel correlation) between 11.9k/159k pool, train, val, test, E1 and across BenchmarkEL releases (same CSIR/ARTS sources), plus same-module pairs across splits, before any pool-based result enters the benchmark.
min_experiment: No training: run retrieval, report count of test/E1 cells with pool or train near-duplicates; re-score any pool-based arm without them. Kill: none (integrity check).
evidence: R: documents leakage across visual benchmarks sourced from overlapping collections (abstract-level).
